test_title: PYST 13: SSC MTS - Reasoning (Held on: 8 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

I. Some M are P.

II. All X are M.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some P are X.

II. Some P are M.

III. No P is X.

options.text: Only conclusions I and II follow

solution:
Statements:

I. Some M are P.

II. All X are M.

The least possible diagram for the given statements is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6c924257f977cd132cf06f258a1f819a9ce684c25181510ce8b1b0868b09d4a2.png] 

Conclusions:

(i) Some P are X - False (Because no direct related given between P and X, so it can be possible not definite).

(ii) Some P are M - **True** (Because Some M are P, so some P are also M).

(III) No P is X - False (Because, negative conclusion can't be definitely true in positive statement).

Here, Only conclusion II follows.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
